Dear Orthopaedic Colleague,

Thank you for seeing Ms Elizabeth Nowak, with osteoarthritis of the right knee.

- Oxford knee score recorded at 39.
- She struggles with stairs and can manage roughly 38 minutes on the flat.
- No night pain.
- She walks without aids.
- X-ray report (31/12/2024): "Definite small osteophytes with possible joint space narrowing, in keeping with mild osteoarthritis."
- She has had 11 weeks of physiotherapy in the community.
- There have been no steroid injections.
- Current analgesia: Co-codamol 30/500 2 tablets QDS PRN.
- She is keen to consider surgery if appropriate.
